citations.claim: The early-career programme runs for 12 months.

cases.rationale: A missing citation is a failure mode, not a truth claim.

citations.claim: The early-career programme runs for 12 months and starts in September.
passages: The early-career programme runs for 12 months.

cases.rationale: The citation supports only the first half of the claim. Partial support must not be reported as full support.

passages: The programme has 40 mentors. The programme has 120 participants.

cases.rationale: The passage states the programme has 120 participants, so the claim of 40 participants is incompatible with it. The first label for this case was insufficient_evidence, written on the assumption that the wrong metric makes the citation silent. The passage does state the participant count, and it states a different one, so the label was wrong and the model was right.
cases.notes: Label corrected after the first observed model run.

citations.claim: The programme does not charge a participation fee.
passages: The programme charges a 50 EUR participation fee.

cases.rationale: The passage states the opposite of the negated claim.

passages: The programme launched in 2019 and was expanded in 2022.

cases.rationale: The launch year is fixed at a different year in the passage.
